default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-968.title: Prior-day close location bias on VWAP cross
E-968.hypothesis: A session that closed in the top (bottom) of its range leaves trapped shorts (longs) and carry-over bias; the next day's cross back across VWAP on that side is followed.

E-969.title: Tweezer top/bottom at a range extreme
E-969.hypothesis: Two consecutive bars of opposite colour printing the same extreme at an n-minute high/low show a defended level; stops sit behind it and the reversal is faded into.

E-970.title: Dry-up pullback resume
E-970.hypothesis: In an EMA trend, a pullback of falling closes on shrinking volume lacks sellers; the first bar through the prior bar's extreme resumes the trend.

E-971.title: Volume-weighted lean cross
E-971.hypothesis: When the n-minute volume-weighted average sits above the plain average, volume traded at higher prices: buyers are the aggressors; follow the crossing of the lean threshold.

E-972.title: Largest-bar midpoint failure
E-972.hypothesis: The widest bar of the last n minutes is a thrust; if the next bar closes back through its midpoint the thrust is rejected and late entrants are trapped, so fade it.

E-973.title: Clock-block engulfing candle follow
E-973.hypothesis: A block candle (15/30/60 min) of one colour that engulfs the previous opposite block shows control changing hands at a timeframe where position traders act; follow it.

E-974.title: Volume-clock mark momentum
E-974.hypothesis: Sampling by traded volume (fractions of the typical session volume) instead of clock time, the move since the previous mark tends to be continued by the flow that produced it.

E-975.title: VWAP dwell share breakout
E-975.hypothesis: A price that spent most of the last hour on one side of VWAP is under persistent institutional pressure; a fresh 15-minute extreme on that side continues.

E-976.title: First-bar range multiple extension
E-976.hypothesis: The first bar of the session marks the initial auction range; a close a full multiple of that range beyond it shows one-sided participation and follows through.

E-977.title: MACD amplitude peak rollover fade
E-977.hypothesis: When trend momentum (MACD magnitude) falls off its n-minute peak the push is spent; fade back toward the mean.
